explication: PostgREST exposes a REST API over an existing PostgreSQL database. A client request is parsed, authenticated, planned, translated into SQL, executed using pooled connections, and formatted as an HTTP response. The database supplies schema-derived resources and authorization through its roles; database schemas support API versioning. The README also identifies JWT authentication, RPC, range metadata, and OpenAPI as product capabilities. The tree supports these subsystem boundaries, but the sampled source only covers load-test utilities, so detailed internal call wiring is inferred conservatively from the documented architecture.
